notes:
- Game Assets add-on 2.1 – redesigned for graphic artists: pick your engine once (Godot, Unity, Unreal, web) and every tool shows the finished result first, with one button; every setting is a visible switch, button or − / + control
- Game Assets: new normal-map maker (2D sprites, tiling textures, from a height map, combining two normal maps) with a lit preview
- Game Assets: proportional resize to a power of two, atlas packing that can shrink sprites to fit, per-sprite scale / same height / same width, PBR maps found in the folder automatically
- Game Assets: much faster on big textures (slicing a 4K sheet: 5 s → under 1 s), and the panel no longer jumps when you click settings
